say:1:1631219001:0.text: You big liar! You finally show your beak! Do you know how long I've been waiting?!
say:1:1631219001:0.source_cn: 你！你这个大骗子！你终于敢出现了！你知道我傻乎乎地等了...

say:2:1631219002:0.text: Why did you stand me up?! Were you off flirting with that preening white pigeon in the plaza?!
say:2:1631219002:0.source_cn: 说，为什么要“放鸽子”！是不是又跟广场上那只总摆造型的...

say:3:1631219003:0.text: Stand you up?! I was on time! Preened my chest feathers three times! I searched all day, my beak is nearly worn to a nub! Where were you?
say:3:1631219003:0.source_cn: 放、放鸽子？我哪敢呀！我准时到的，还把胸口的羽毛梳理了...

say:4:1631219004:0.source_cn: 还狡辩！我明明一直在这儿！

narration:5:1631219005:1.text: She swoops at him, but passes straight through like mist...
narration:5:1631219005:1.male: She swoops at him, but passes straight through like mist...
narration:5:1631219005:1.female: She swoops at him, but passes straight through like mist...

say:6:1631219006:0.text: ... Huh? When did you learn such advanced invisibility magic? Turn it off! Let me peck you a couple of times to vent, and maybe I'll forgive you!
say:6:1631219006:0.source_cn: ……咦？你……你什么时候学会了这么高级的隐身魔法？快解...

say:7:1631219007:0.text: I... I didn't... Why do you look so light? Like you'd fall apart if touched...
say:7:1631219007:0.source_cn: 我、我没有啊……你怎么看起来……轻飘飘的？好像……一碰...

say:8:1631219008:1.text: You gently explain that the parrot passed away before the date. Unable to see one another, you used magic to briefly bridge life and death.
say:8:1631219008:1.source_cn: 你轻声向它们解释，这位鹦鹉女士在约会前不幸去世。因此它...
say:8:1631219008:1.male: You gently explain that the parrot passed away before the date. Unable to see one another, you used magic to briefly bridge life and death.
say:8:1631219008:1.female: You gently explain that the parrot passed away before the date. Unable to see one another, you used magic to briefly bridge life and death.

say:9:1631219009:1.text: G-ghost...? I'm... dead? When did that happen? I didn't feel a thing...
say:9:1631219009:1.source_cn: 幽……幽灵？我……我……我已经……死了？什么时候的事？...

say:10:1631219010:1.source_cn: 死……死了？！呜……怎么会这样……我们的面包屑大餐……

say:11:1631219011:1.text: Grief settles over the two birds like a frozen hush. You quietly step away, leaving them to share their final moments in silence.
say:11:1631219011:1.source_cn: 突如其来的悲痛笼罩了两只鸟儿，空气仿佛凝固了。你默默地...
say:11:1631219011:1.male: Grief settles over the two birds like a frozen hush. You quietly step away, leaving them to share their final moments in silence.
say:11:1631219011:1.female: Grief settles over the two birds like a frozen hush. You quietly step away, leaving them to share their final moments in silence.
